A current of $7.7~\text{A}$ is passed through a solution containing $\text{Al}^{3+}$ ions for $56~\text{minutes}$. Calculate the mass of $\text{Al}$ deposited at the cathode. ($M_\text{Al} = 27.0~\text{g/mol}$, $F = 96485~\text{C/mol}$)
explanation: $Q = It = 25856.69~\text{C}$. $n_e = \frac{Q}{F} = 0.268~\text{mol}$. The ion requires $3~\text{mol}$ of electrons per mole of metal, so $n_{\text{metal}} = \frac{0.268}{3} = 0.0893~\text{mol}$. Mass = $n \times M = (0.0893)(27.0) \approx 2.41~\text{g}$.
